Sine & cosine

Coordinates of uniform circular motion vary periodically. Amplitude, frequency and phase set the size, rate and starting point.

A sin(2πft + φ)

Phase, radians and cycles per second

θ marks progress through a cycle. A radian angle is arc length divided by radius; one turn is2π rad. f counts cycles per second (Hz), T is seconds per cycle, and ω=2πf measures radians per second; T=1/f. In the sine formula, φ sets the starting phase.

Harmonic motion

An ideal spring has a restoring force proportional and opposite to displacement. Without damping or driving, its motion is sinusoidal.

m x″ + kx = 0

What do x′ and x″ mean?

x is position relative to equilibrium (m). x′=dx/dt is signed velocity (m/s); differentiating once more gives x″=d²x/dt², acceleration (m/s²). Two primes mean two time derivatives, not x squared.

Derivatives & instantaneous rates

A derivative is an instantaneous rate and tangent slope. For position versus time it gives signed velocity; differentiating velocity gives acceleration.

f′(t) = lim Δf/Δt

Net force & Newton’s second law

In an inertial frame with constant mass, the sum of external forces equals mass times acceleration. It determines how velocity changes, not the current velocity.

ΣF = m a

Definite integral & signed accumulation

A definite integral accumulates signed contributions. Over forward time, integrating velocity gives displacement; integrating speed gives distance. Position difference is distinct from a position coordinate.

∫aᵇ v dt = x(b) − x(a)

Pulse-width modulation

Vary switch ON time within a fixed period. Duty is the fraction of the period spent ON.

D = ton / T

Buck converter

CCM means inductor current never reaches zero during a cycle, not that it stays constant. With ideal components, periodic steady state and constant DC input, average output voltage is D times input; instantaneous voltage can ripple.

⟨Vout⟩ = D Vin

A transient is extra motion associated with the initial state; it decays in this positive-damping model. Steady state is the sustained periodic motion left afterward, not rest. Viscous damping removes energy through a force opposing velocity. Here φ is displacement’s phase difference relative to the driving force.

Probability models

Use probabilities to describe possible outcomes and uncertainty. Model probabilities are distinct from observed evidence.

0 ≤ P(A) ≤ 1

Bayesian updating

A prior is a probability before evidence; a posterior is its update afterward. Likelihood describes evidence under a hypothesis—in this lesson’s discrete examples it is an observation probability. Combine it with the prior and normalize; the result depends on the observation model.

posterior ∝ likelihood × prior

正弦与余弦

匀速绕圆运动的坐标随时间周期变化。振幅、频率和相位分别决定大小、快慢和起点。

A sin(2πft + φ)

相位、弧度与每秒周期数

θ 表示一周期内的进度。弧度是弧长除以半径，一周为 2π rad。f 是每秒周期数（Hz），T 是一周期的秒数，ω=2πf 是每秒变化的弧度数（rad/s），T=1/f。正弦式中的 φ 设定起始相位。

OpenStax · 周期与角频率 ↗

简谐振动

理想弹簧振子的回复力与位移成正比、方向相反。在无阻尼、无持续外力驱动时，位移随时间呈正弦变化；回复力仍然存在。

m x″ + kx = 0

x′ 和 x″ 分别读什么？

x 是相对平衡位置的坐标（m）。x′=dx/dt 是带方向的速度（m/s）；再对时间求一次导数，x″=d²x/dt² 就是加速度（m/s²）。两个撇号表示求两次导数，不是把 x 平方。

条件：A>0、m>0、k>0；理想水平弹簧，无阻尼、无持续驱动。

物块经过平衡位置 x=0 时，速度也一定为零吗？先预测，再展开解释。

导数与瞬时变化率

可微函数的导数是瞬时变化率，也是切线斜率。位置对时间的导数是带方向的速度，速度对时间的导数是加速度。

f′(t) = lim Δf/Δt

净力与牛顿第二定律

在惯性参考系、质量恒定时，合外力等于质量乘加速度。它决定速度如何改变，而不是此刻速度有多大。

ΣF = m a

定积分与有符号累加

定积分累加带符号的贡献。在正向时间区间，速度积分是位移，速率积分才是路程；位置差与位置坐标不同。

∫aᵇ v dt = x(b) − x(a)

D = ton / T

Buck 降压电路

电源间歇接入。连续导通 CCM 指电感电流全周期不归零，不是恒定电流。理想周期稳态、直流输入恒定时，平均输出电压为 D 倍输入；瞬时值可有纹波。

⟨Vout⟩ = D Vin

暂态是初始状态带来的额外运动，在本页正阻尼模型中会衰减。稳态是随后保留的持续周期运动，不是静止；黏性阻尼通过反向于速度的力耗能。响应图中的 φ 是位移相对驱动力的相位差。

0 ≤ P(A) ≤ 1

贝叶斯更新

先验是观测前的概率，后验是观测后的更新。似然描述给定假设下观测如何出现；本页离散例子中是观测概率。把它与先验结合并归一化，得到依赖观测模型的后验。

后验 ∝ 似然 × 先验
